physics.endpoint_snap: After14 actual forward updates, numerical endpoint discrepancies below1e-5m are snapped to the exact shared target before the final visible observation.
physics.stop_intervention: Explicitly set vf,vs,vr to0 after the last visible update; then execute a native turn action. This is a controlled stationary-state assay, not a claim that native turn commands instantly brake.
physics.target_variable: Last actual travel direction, fixed during the stationary turn; body heading continues changing

input_condition: Only current predictive slots are released to ordinary grid; actual saved goal and all other inputs preserved
interpretation: The released full-state family remembers last actual travel direction under one common input. Native cue trajectories receive phase-specific sensory input and are labelled input-driven; they are not an autonomous-ring test.
context_collection: Fresh original-policy rollouts with continuous RGB, first two physically eligible windows from distinct slots
